# Blewett

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P13](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P15](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0015)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Peter Blewett](../character/peter-blewett.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

Mrs. [Peter Blewett](../character/peter-blewett.md) is a small, sharp-faced woman with a shrewish appearance and sharp eyes. She possesses a very thin frame, lacking even an ounce of superfluous flesh on her bones.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P10](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P13](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0013)_

## Personality

Blewett is known for having a notable temper. Furthermore, reports from her former servant girls indicate that she possesses a stingy nature.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P10](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0010)_

## Traits

- presumed stingy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P10](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0010)</sub>
